local_validation.result: debug JVM/Robolectric suites for the three flavors (mobile, quest, lite), release lint and the APK checker tests passed in a cloud container without the Discord SDK
local_validation.ci_validation: run 44397423199: release builds, debug and release unit tests, UI text audit, lint, APK signature pin and Discord bridge packaging passed
local_validation.host_previews: Robolectric software renders on the host (not a phone), looked at by the main agent or the sub-agents: the restored GTA VI welcome (phone), tablet dock scrubber and line; web player lyrics screenshots at 390 px and 1440 px with a fixture title (Playwright)

statements: Remet l’ancien ecran de enjoy GTA VI et aussi ameliore ketmix pour qu’il soit au meme niveau que celui d’apple music entraine toi sur des millier de donne que tu cherche sur PLEIN de site pour comprendre comment fonctionne automix d’apple music et les transitions etc pour faire ketmix une meilleur version continue d’optimiser l’app lite et le site web doit avoir les parole en syllabes etc. Ne n’utilise pas plus de 70% de mon quota de 5 heure.

done.welcome: the owner's GTA VI welcome picture and glass panel restored; theme unchanged
done.ketmix: blend length by fit, vocal-over-vocal guards, pickup-aware bars, outgoing level lead-down, gapless and beatless albums left unmixed
done.lite: lazy translations, kept blur pyramid on Android 11, tablet dock drawn in the draw phase
done.web: word and syllable timed lyrics in the web player (deployed to the site; proposed server route not deployed)

not_done.training: no model was trained on data; web research was turned into explicit planner rules
not_done.quota: the 70 % limit could not be measured from the session; three lean agents and one full validation were used
not_done.ketmix: far-tempo pairs keep Echo/Rise instead of a plain crossfade; no outro looping

not_validated: physical phone, Lite, tablet or Quest installation, rendering and behaviour of 6.7.0
Ketmix transitions by ear on any device
the kept blur pyramid on a real Android 11 device (relies on the renderer refreshing layers when the page scrolls behind)
frame times, start-up time and memory on devices
web player lyrics with real songs, on Safari/iOS and with YouTube-iframe playback
Robolectric runs on the Android 11 runtime (sdk 30)
known_limitations: No Wear OS app in this version.
Seasonal themes use code-drawn decor until the owner's pictures are added.
Android Auto's queue screen shows only the current song.
Switching between Ketvoice and Ketvoice Lite is a manual install of the other APK.
Ketogether guests hear titles their own sources can play; local files and private titles are shown as unavailable.
Launcher icons keep a background: Android fills adaptive icon backgrounds in black.
The signing certificate is the existing public Android debug identity, not a private production key.
